props.gloss_en: the mishnah: one who was reading in the Torah when the time for its recitation arrived -- if he focused his heart, he has fulfilled [his obligation]
mitzvot require intent (proposed as what the mishnah's clause proves)
what is 'if he focused his heart'? -- [he intended] to read
[the mishnah speaks] of one reading in order to proofread

objections.gloss_en: לקרות?! והא קא קרי! -- intent to read? but he is already reading

answered_by.gloss_en: בקורא להגיה -- the case is one reading to proofread, so 'focused his heart' adds the intent to read the words (= p_korei_lehagiah)
